output.question: Where can I find Coca-Cola's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, Coca-Cola's latest annual report is its FY 2025 Form 10-K, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. It is available as an HTML filing on Coca-Cola Investor Relations here: https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-26-010047/ko-20251231.htm. The company's Financial Information page also lists the FY 2025 10-K and provides the XBRL download.

key_facts.fact: Coca-Cola's Investor Relations Financial Information page lists FY 2025 and identifies the fiscal year end as December 31, 2025.
The FY 2025 annual report is available as a direct 10-K HTML filing at https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-26-010047/ko-20251231.htm.
The filing is Coca-Cola's Form 10-K annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.

passages.quote:
FORM 10-K

ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934

For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
passages.publisher: The Coca-Cola Company / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing

caveats: This identifies the latest annual filing posted on Coca-Cola's Investor Relations page as of 2026-11-11; a later filing could supersede it after that date.
The direct link is the HTML Form 10-K filing rather than a separately designed glossy annual-report PDF.
